nodes.name: Receive Outcome
nodes.notes: Select Header Auth with Name X-Threshold-Token and Value set to the n8n_outcome deployment secret.

nodes.name: Calculate Outcome Signature
nodes.notes: Select a separate Crypto credential named Threshold Outcome HMAC using the n8n_outcome deployment secret. Its secret must match Receive Outcome Header Auth.

nodes.name: Update Existing HubSpot Ticket
nodes.notes: Select a HubSpot Bearer Auth credential with permission to update tickets.
